tier_should.rationale: Introduces principled TVA for large factorial RCTs, with selection, pooling, and winner’s-curse adjustment; theory and simulations support credibility; strong application on immunization shows sizable, policy-relevant effects. Methodological novelty suits top field econometrics/applied venues.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authorship, clear policy relevance, and robust empirical results make A-journal consideration plausible; if not, leading field journals in econometrics or development. Some inference caveats (conditional on selection) may deter the very top general outlets.
